newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Pacific Bank opens 15 pct down.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Pacific Bank opens 15 pct down.

text.p: Shares of Malaysia's Pacific Bank Bhd opened 15 percent lower on Monday after talks between it and Singapore's Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation failed to conclude a much-expected merger.
Around 0145 GMT Pacific Bank shares were down 1.50 ringgit to 8.50 ringgit.

On Friday, OCBC said in a statement issued in Singapore that talks on the proposed merger between the Malaysian operations of the bank and Pacific Bank had been terminated due to legal and accounting problems which could not be resolved.
In Singapore at 0200 GMT shares of OCBC dropped five Singapore cents to S$9.25.
